title: Your story is part of the journey too.
description: Note how you feel, what helps, and what you want to remember. These notes are yours alone.
descriptionLive: Your entries are saved to your account. No one else sees them from this screen.
descriptionDemo: This view uses local examples to show the space. Nothing is sent to your account.
quotes: Each note is a way of knowing yourself a little better.
You do not need to write a lot. Honest and brief is enough.
Noticing is not judging. It is giving yourself a moment of clarity.

summary.streakHelp: Consecutive days with at least one note. Breaking the run has no penalty.
summary.wellbeingHint: How you have felt, over the last four weeks.
summary.wellbeingHelp: Average of the 0–10 ratings you chose. It is not a clinical score.

overview.calendarHint: Days with a note are marked.
overview.calendarHelp: Empty days are not flagged or penalized.
overview.calendarMonthEmpty: This month has no notes. Empty days are not marked.
overview.evolutionHint: How your wellbeing has moved, from what you wrote down.
overview.evolutionHelp: Only days with a rating appear. Gaps are not filled. It is not a clinical score.
overview.evolutionEmpty: When you note how you feel, the line will appear here.
overview.emotionsHint: What you have tagged most often.
overview.emotionsHelp: Share of tagged entries that include each emotion. Totals need not be 100%.
overview.emotionsEmpty: When you tag emotions on your entries, they will appear here by frequency.
overview.lastEmpty: There is no recent entry yet.
overview.lastPhotoHint: Decorative image. It is not a photo of you.
overview.highlightsEmpty: Mark an entry as highlighted when you want to return to it.
overview.learningsEmpty: Mark an entry as a learning to gather what helps you.
overview.milestonesHint: The improvements you have noticed in everyday life.
overview.milestonesHelp: You record them yourself. They are not medals or abstinence days.
overview.milestonesEmpty: When you want, log a perceived improvement.

entries.empty: No entries yet. You can start with a short note, an emotion, or how you slept.
entries.dayEmpty: This day has no notes. You can write one whenever you like.
entries.filterEmpty: No entries match these filters. You can widen the dates or clear the marks.

patterns.title: Patterns
patterns.body: This view will be completed later. Soma does not invent correlations or causes from your notes.

milestones.saveError: The milestone could not be saved.

form.wellbeing: How would you rate your overall wellbeing today?
form.wellbeingHint: A personal 0–10 impression. It is not a diagnosis and is not computed from the other scales.
form.title: Title
form.required: Add at least one detail: wellbeing, a scale, an emotion, a trigger, a title, or some text.
form.saveError: Could not save. Please try again.

error: The journal could not be loaded.
emptyOverview: When you are ready, leave a first note. The streak is only informational and there is no average you must hit.
